changelog: The configuration page was blank in 1.0.70.0 and still blank in 1.0.71.0, and this makes it appear. Both releases had the same shape of fault: the page waited to be told to draw itself. 1.0.71.0 added the second event name on the theory that the first one was wrong, and it changed nothing, because no such event arrives here under either name. The page it replaced had in fact never depended on one - it registered a listener and also loaded itself a tick later, and the tick is what drew it, every time, for seventy releases. That line was the part that got left behind. The page now mounts itself as soon as it is in the document and uses the events only to tidy up on the way out, which costs nothing, since loading was already written to be safe to ask for twice. The script has also moved back inside the page element, where the old one lived, so a host that injects only that element cannot drop it. And the loader now leaves a trail of what it did, so a page that comes up empty can say why instead of saying nothing.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
